content: {"reasoning":"The claim is denied CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service). This payer offers no retroactive authorization and no peer-to-peer review, and an appeal on medical necessity does not cure a procedural pre-service auth failure. Since the missing authorization was the provider's responsibility, the balance cannot be shifted to the patient and no available action can recover payment—so it should be closed as provider-liable.","action":"write_off"}
